# SelfOrganizationInContinuousMedia

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process by which global order arises from local continuous interactions in a spatial medium, without central control. Relevant for in-network neuromorphic computing where distributed, adaptive behavior emerges from simple local rules across interconnected nodes.
